notes.title: Dev blog – The Bazaar #2
notes.content:
Here’s the second devblog for the Bazaar area. This time, it features some interior spaces along with outdoor locations.

[h2]Outdoor[/h2]

Here are more WIP screenshots of the outdoor areas from the main street of Bazaar Center, featuring shops, restaurants, a spa and a movie theater. Also a screenshot of the Sewerview Inn, where you can admire the beautiful open sewer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/a90059a91ca686f28de5f6ed1faddad5719f3167.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/72d424f4f6d990e58bebe0387e7ea3a0b7683dd5.png[/img]

[h2]Interiors[/h2]

And here are also some interior screenshots from various locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/1f70db37b9bece79870d6f595c4272d81e99d4bd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/7db13cd832785f2b12befe4777773bc2fde914bc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/cb5b05140d6784ae865cf3a3bd473543e5a5d0c8.png[/img]

[h2]Custom Painting Shop[/h2]

Rob Rosso's Instant Art Shop lets you upload your own images to create custom paintings, flags, and calendars!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/d2c5d1e753b0fcfb380068ceb22e7ce6d625b46e.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/7e73b08f42a37eb55f95d55f93c4fc7c40caebe9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hard Hat with Headlamp[/h2]

In the next update, you'll find the often-requested hard hat with a headlamp, making mining easier in dark areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/67decd5f00f1ab0e82dea87d01dc7cede6a8523f.png[/img]


[h2]New Plants[/h2]

We have also added some new crops and decorative plants, such as apple tree, grape vine, black currant bush, tobacco plant and yucca plant.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/32c9c3e196b294eb216daaa6a6ed097a24d05c89.png[/img]

[h2]Lab Upgrades[/h2]

Effectiveness of the labs can now be improved by placing special furniture nearby, such as distillation kit and sample analyzer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8860e030e0f37ac28166fc6fbfb8cad3e538b857.png[/img]

[h2]Karl Hagen – "King of the Bazaar"[/h2]

Karl Hagen, the "King of the Bazaar," is one of the Bazaar’s founders and its current leader, but due to illness and personal matters, he has delegated day-to-day business management to others.

These are concept artworks of the character him, created some time ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/9ff17328c846bc16d15a6973fc9d64ed714c70fb.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev blog – The Bazaar #1
notes.content:
Here's the first devblog for the bazaar area, where we've mainly focused on working on the exterior. We also just released a smaller update, mainly with bug fixes, but also something new.

Here's a brief introduction to the locations that will be part of the bazaar:

The bazaar can be divided into three areas: the central district with fancier buildings, the slums with makeshift structures, and the industrial zone.

[h2]Bazaar Center[/h2]

The center of the bazaar is a bustling, area free of mushrooms, even attracting the occasional tourist. It offers a variety of services, including a movie theater, spa, internet cafe, jewelry store, casino, and much more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/46b9b2505b0dcbf8403bacc34919cd5fd94c75a5.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/0e56760f1b27042cd30ccc65a6348ead37363a3c.png[/img]

[h2]Slums[/h2]

Adjacent to the bazaar center, the slums are home to mushroom addicts, the poor, and those who have lost everything gambling in the casino.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/6fb377d1555c7171e52c2f0893f0d4df6738beb1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/93ac2d0c330456fc1bc19cc4e8c62f6bf5f8e499.png[/img]

[h2]Industrial Area[/h2]

The industrial district sits next to the Osmo Olut brewery. This is where ore from the mines is processed into goods, some of which are even sold beyond Obenseuer to generate income. The famous Club Bassment is also located here, drawing visitors looking for entertainment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/9d614aa7c6fa9b2fb879c1c48d511f04d4a7f57a.png[/img]

notes.content:
Hello, landlords and myco-excavators, it's time for another round of bug fixes with some new additions!

[h2]Gas Mask[/h2]

The Gas Mask is a new item that protects you from mushroom spores longer than a regular face mask.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/5097a81ee48a340edfe85fd68074e983bab30582.png[/img]

[h2]New Task[/h2]

A new task was added where you have to find a specific minitrain miniature for Mikkel, and he’ll help you with minitrain speed camera!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8da2e3f6d4b789ae7f6ccdb54d213605ee85d1a7.png[/img]

[list]

notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8a7c17dbddf7d9efe88e6c674178b050e675f0cc.png[/img]

The mines contain network of long tunnels what can be explored with your locomotive.

It is possible to couple wagons into a long train, and haul rocks and ore into processing area for some sweet sweet cash. But be aware that driving around consumes precious diesel.

With minitrains, we're also adding a new line of tenement upgrades; a mining depot connected straight to the mines.

notes.title: Dev blog – The Mines #2
notes.content:
Over the last month we have continued to develop the mines and added some new features and improvements. Here are some new things to come:

[h2]Liquid storages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/f9a126ba3f087019d8d247cd324dc2f6dc3dc316.png[/img]
There will be liquid storages, such as barrels or makeshift sinks, where you can store liquids.  It's also possible to take a shower in any liquid you want, such as beer, mushroom water or sulfuric acid!

This means that the early tenement upgrades with makeshift-tier tanks and barrels now have a limited supply of water. But don't worry, when you ran out, you can ask Ol' Malone to refill the storages for you.

Also, as Obenseuer is a place known for its nonpotable tap water, O-Market has stocked itself with large 10L canisters of fresh spring water.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/461ae8a78fafc8d5e3ff130be3fa31edc06ba082.png[/img]

With the drawing board, you can draw blueprints, instead of relying on blueprints scattered around the district. You can get started with just some paper and duct tape, but for more complex furniture blueprints you'll need more advanced stuff, such as a math/tables book.

We have also added other content such as:
[list]
[*] Balanced output quality of self-made alcohols and farming. Now some easier early game (sugar, turnip) mashes doesn't automatically turn out crap, having less value than the ingredients.
[*] Rent payment interval options
[*] New furniture such as ore crusher, plastic barrel shower, makeshift IBC sink and pillows
[*] New items such as rat trap, spring water and 10L water bottle
[/list]

notes.title: Dev blog – The Mines #1
notes.content:
In the last few months we have been solely working on a major upcoming district zone, The Mines.
As per tradition, our devblogs don't tend to be long posts, so let's get straight into it.

[h2]Upcoming areas[/h2]

[h3]Mines[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/bf4c87338719e5fe3d228be1e362a1fbed303dd3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/9956948ade0ca842322cee47be3f178dabd64913.png[/img]
The Mines are a large zone with a maze of tunnels, buried secrets and new services for convenience.
Among with rocks and, umm, more rocks, the mines comes with a narrow-gauge railway network, you can use to traverse the tunnels and shunting carriages full of ore you have mined. The mines will also provide with new opportunities of tenement upgrades.

[h3]Tenement A[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/310a0f3ad3ee4d8bb0ee8ba6ac153a2496a26416.png[/img]
Tenement A, a large habitation block near the market area, provides a new, and less depressing, job opportunity. The block also hosts, or well, used to host a hospital dedicated at helping the victims of the fungal disease.

[h3]Open Sewer Metro[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/840ac9bac144765740c794c4937e008b8cedf54b.png[/img]
The 'Open Sewer Metro', a local network of smuggling tunnels of an unknown original purpose will serve as a metro system connecting districts of Obenseuer.

[h3]Other new locations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/61e09284799a04f2080d13d0af87a82da928988a.png[/img]
A few smaller new task-related locations are coming, like Bank of Bazaar where you can rob the bank vault.

[h2]New animals[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8c014766d049815fa70b8b737f837d51bb0d85a9.png[/img]
Chicken coops can be installed in tenement to provide with an income of chicken meat, feathers and eggs. Oh, you can also breed cats.

Your cat has also passed the inspection of the administration, and will be delivered to you.

[h2]Newspapers and magazines[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/84e3c4c7d546d7425282eb155df5c8155d6c977d.png[/img]
O-Market sells daily newspapers from the outside world. You can read newspapers to pass time and gain a small mental health boost from reading the news.

Daily lifehack magazine will also arrive in an item form, what can be read at your leisure to gain invaluable knowledge of crafting recipes.
It is now also possible to subscribe to the Open Sewer magazine, which will also provide recipes and small amount of random skill per volume.

[h2]Other upcoming additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] New crafting stations, such as electronics and sewing station.
[*] New furniture such as editable signs, cages, rugs and a head lantern
[*] New items such as ores, Bobby and vanilla ice cream
[*] New recipes
[*] Several bug fixes and other additions
[/list]

Full list of upcoming changes can be found out by wading through our changelog:
[url=https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md]https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md[/url]

notes.content:
Hello,

Time for another update of bugfixes and a few additions for Obenseuer.

[h3]Difficulty settings[/h3]

You can now select a custom difficulty where you can change several settings such as needs speed, renovation cost, and addiction recovery speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/a2d90376c7dda70a39768a82b7c749692e53f054.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hygiene and radiation[/h3]

Two new stats have been added.

The hygiene which decreases slowly, but you can use the shower to wash yourself. Too low hygiene exposes you to fungal disease.

The radiation is hidden stat, which can be checked by Dr. Pena or using a dosimeter, which you will need in the mines. Also pharmacy now sells iodine pills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/b447e3b893151df97149105cdecc9406c2ed47bf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Sleeping events[/h3]

There are several different types of sleeping events, such as the police can take you to jail or someone can infect you with a fungal disease.

[h3]Mask slot and dishwasher[/h3]

There is currently one item for the face slot, a face mask which provides protection against fungi. Face masks can be bought at the pharmacy. A dirty mask also quickly reduces hygiene.

Dishwasher can be used to wash away the owner of the items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/22e187b9e1bb42fe3c98040a404cff950c8e84f2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other additions and changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added ability to move items quickly by holding down the mouse button
[*] Added processing time for crafting furniture
[*] Added a second autosave slot
[*] Added ability to remove save slots
[*] Increased spoilage times
[*] Increased farming payment
[*] Increased mash payment
[*] Rebalanced renovation costs

notes.title: Update December 22nd 2023 (Version 0.3.26)
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for December 22nd 2023 (Version 0.3.26)[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/fe3e7421d5dfd71a66c85de651c6c083bc264d73.jpg[/img]

Hello mycomancers, moonshiners and landlords,

Today we have some fairly decently sized chunk of additions and bug fixes for Obenseuer.

Starting from the most major one:

[h3]Ability to clean up other apartments and public areas[/h3]

Now all the clutter in the stairwell, public areas and apartments can be picked and cleaned up in a newly added cleaning mode. Collecting all the leftover furniture will give healthy starting boost for business.
To balance it, contractor now requires apartments to be mostly cleaned up before starting any upgrades, and getting rid of those nasty mushroom infestations requires some cleaning chemicals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/1b7c2499ccdbde7770ff911a0e7486532ba09bd4.jpg[/img]
On top of furniture collecting and cleaning, you can now place furniture on stairwell.

[h3]Map markers[/h3]

Or more like map stickers.  Discovering a noteworthy location will now add a marker sticker on the map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/2ba28fc4036bcd9f6967e688093587ddd749e05f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Job(s)[/h3]

You can now grind your soul on mindless (and depression inducing) telemarketing job for meager amount of local currency. Good option if you're low on money and have extra time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/536ec466de47a28739e9c650cf06e6853d39f478.jpg[/img]

[h3]Other additions and changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added new achievements
[*] Added production chains for new rice and milk based alcoholic drinks
[*] Added a tons of new furniture
[*] Lanterns can now be attached (snapped) to hooks and chains
[*] Added more variation for tenant furnishings
[*] Added gift stall to the market square
[*] O-market now sells take-away coffee
[*] High tier food items (such as pizzas and pies) now have multiple uses
[*] Added 'drinking' skill and related achievement
[/list]

Full changelog can be read here:
https://github.com/loiste-interactive/Obenseuer-Issues/blob/main/CHANGES.md

notes.title: A Long overdue progress report
notes.content:
Oh well, it's been one year since we last made an update post here...

As you may have already noticed, we're notoriously bad at writing posts (other than posting random screenshots on Discord), so it's about time to bring you up to date.

Anyway, here are some of the key features we have been working on during the past year or so.


[h1]Apartment upgrades[/h1]

The apartment upgrade system has been remade, among with all apartment upgrades.
The new apartment upgrade system is more versatile and allows turnip grade mixes of super luxurious kitchens in shabby apartments and so on.

In the upcoming version there are going to be 4 basic tiers of rentable apartments on top of the base frame of the tenement, all divided into parts that will be upgraded separately.

There's also going to be an additional fifth tier later on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/5fad9c159e11f90711743061909a7962103d2c8d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8620f68c122777461abb89478873a39cb8f3a4f3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/47aec19607f96c3e0c0a66621e4fa858548fd46b.png[/img]


[h1]Crafting and cooking[/h1]

The crafting system has also gone through some major changes. In the old version items were crafted instantaneously, excluding items crafted in ovens and alcohol production, and devices were always powered.

Now all the crafting processes take some time to complete depending on the recipe and the quality of the equipment used. Another major change is that some of the equipment now requires to be fueled for it to be usable. Low tier barrel stoves require burnable fuel such as firewood to work, while higher tier electric stoves require the station to be powered with electricity. 

Some recipes now have a chance of failure, like burning a turnip, which also depends on the quality of the equipment used. Besides the success chance, speed and fuel requirement, the level of the equipment also contributes to how many items you are able to craft simultaneously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33905978/8231eec4c47d9e584463af7cd4918a5f8d1df27e.png[/img]


[h1]Tasks and notes[/h1]

The upcoming version will finally have a proper quest system, where all the active, ongoing and completed tasks are displayed with all of their stages.

The new quest system will also feature a notes -tab where all the different notes, scribbles and other readable material will be stored.


[h1]What's next?[/h1]

We recently started working on a new NPC system and AI, allowing us to bring more life to the depressing and melancholy streets of Obenseuer. Other than that, we will continue to work on implementing quests and building the environments.
